correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the incoming-state Laplace backward system with generator matrix [[s+a,-a],[a,-(s+a)]], right absorbing u_+(1,s)=1 and sticky wall u_-(0,s)=(a+g)u_+(0,s)/(a+g+s). Matrix square s(s+2a)I yields exact initial transform F(s)=1/[cosh(z)+s(s+2a+g)/(s+a+g) sinh(z)/z]. Comparing the transform low-order expansion and independent backward moment ODEs in the inspected verifier recovers EY=1+a+a/(a+g) and the displayed rational variance. Independently differentiated the variance: V_a=2Q/[3(a+g)^3], Q_aa=24a²+(36g+24)a+12g²+24g>0, Q_g>=3 for a>=0,g>=0. For h(g)=min_{a>=0}Q(a,g), h(0)<0 by a=1/4, h(1)>0 by positive coefficients, and h strictly increases, establishing a unique positive double root and the exact stationary point count. At that nondegenerate root Q_g,Q_aa>0, Taylor with sqrt(g_c-g) yields the claimed coefficient; mean derivative 1+g/(a+g)^2>0. Numerical nondegenerate roots and moment identities checked symbolically, but are not substitutes for the global convexity proof.
